title: Data model for a Biocorner mortar recipe
description: CIRCULOOS data model for a Biocorner bio-based mortar formulation, covering the secondary raw materials it combines, its mixing and curing parameters and the organization that developed it.

anyOf.description: Exact value as a number, or a range as an object with minValue and/or maxValue.
Exact measured value, when a single figure is known.

minValue.description: Lower bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a minimum.

maxValue.description: Upper bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a maximum.

value.description: Exact value as a number, or a range as an object with minValue and/or maxValue.

anyOf.description: Exact measured value, when a single figure is known.

minValue.description: Lower bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a minimum.

maxValue.description: Upper bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a maximum.

unitCode.description: UN/CEFACT code of the unit of measurement of the value.

anyOf.description: URNs of the referenced entities, each with the format urn:ngsi-ld:<type>:<id>.

object.description: URNs of the referenced entities, each with the format urn:ngsi-ld:<type>:<id>.

anyOf.description: URN of the referenced entity, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:<type>:<id>.

object.description: URN of the referenced entity, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:<type>:<id>.

id.description: Property. Unique entity identifier, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:Recipe:<id>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be Recipe

name.description: Property. Descriptive name of the recipe identifying the primary SRM and formulation variant for internal reference and traceability.

formulation.description: Property. Quantitative composition summary listing each component with its percentage by weight, including both SRM components and conventional binders or additives.

processingInstructions.description: Property. Step-by-step manufacturing procedure including mixing parameters, component addition sequence, timing, and environmental conditions for production.

developedBy.description: Relationship. Relationship to the Organization entity that developed and validated this formulation through laboratory testing and characterisation.

containsSRM.description: Relationship. SRM entities combined in this formulation, listed with the primary (main bio-based) secondary raw material first.

mixingTime.description: Property. Expected unitCode: MIN. Total duration of the mixing process, from initial component blending to final homogeneous mixture ready for application or casting.

curingDuration.description: Property. Expected unitCode: DAY. Required curing period before the product reaches its declared performance characteristics under standard reference conditions.

waterBinderRatio.description: Property. Dimensionless. Mass ratio of water to binder content in the formulation. Critical parameter controlling workability, strength development, and porosity of the final product.
